avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 induction; increases sertraline metabolism and reduces efficacy; serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; allow 2-week washout before starting or after stopping sertraline

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, confusion)
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor amplifies serotonergic effects; serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use with sertraline; discuss alternative supplements with provider

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Opioid with SNRI activity; significant serotonin syndrome and seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use alternative analgesia (acetaminophen, NSAIDs if appropriate)

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; sertraline may increase bleeding risk when combined
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising or bleeding; assess benefit-risk ratio

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high-dose >2g/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet properties may potentiate sertraline-associated bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Use standard dietary doses; monitor if high-dose supplementation needed

caution_supplements.name: L-tryptophan supplement
caution_supplements.mechanism: Increased serotonin precursor availability; minor additive serotonergic effects
caution_supplements.action: Avoid or use minimal doses; monitor for serotonergic symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Sertraline has minimal MAOI activity; risk is substantially lower than traditional MAOIs but modest interaction possible
avoid_foods.action: Normal dietary tyramine intake is safe; extreme restriction unnecessary

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase sertraline levels and side effects
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid grapefruit; monitor for increased dizziness, nausea, or sexual dysfunction

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depression; increases sedation and impairs judgment/motor control
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol; if consumed, use minimal quantities and monitor response

caution_foods.name: Caffeine (high intake >400mg/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS stimulation may increase anxiety, tremor, or insomnia in sertraline-treated patients
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; reduce if anxiety or sleep disturbances occur

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, dilated pupils, muscle rigidity) especially with supplements or concurrent medications affecting serotonin. Educate patient on bleeding risk with concurrent NSAIDs or antiplatelet agents and counsel on alcohol moderation.
